name: Proto-Greater Micronesian
notes: An alternative grouping only: Jackson (1986: 211-214) tentatively groups Nauruan with the Micronesian languages as Greater Micronesian, Nauruan being a sister of PMC (it keeps POC *nt and *nd apart, which PMC merges as *c). 'The reconstruction of Proto-Greater Micronesian must wait until another time' (p. 213): no rows. In the main tree Nauruan is a Micronesian language under PMc (Hughes 2020a, b; Blumenfeld 2022b). Members through alt_parents (decision jackson1986-pgmc).
